# @puristic/env

> 标签: 12-factor, config, configuration, dotenv, dotenvx, encryption, env, env-vars, environment-variables, post-quantum, schema, secrets, type-safe, typescript, validation, varlock, zod

## 简介

A config loader built on one Zod schema — the same schema drives CI validation, codegen, and post-quantum encrypted secrets. No DSL, no cloud.
